paite: Kuapeuh salh a om nak a, genhak teitei hihdamna om lou in thakhat in akise ding hi.
Midiktatte apun chiang un, mite akipak uh; himahleh migilou in vaihawmna apuak chiang in, mite amau uh.
Kuapeuh pilna it in apa akipaksak a; himahleh kuapeuh kizuakte kithuahpih in asum amawk zatbei hi.
Kumpipa'n vaihawmna in gam ahihkip a; himahleh kuapeuh thilpiak phut teitei in ahihsia hi.
Mi invengte maitangphat in kalsuante a ding in len azaksak hi.
Mihoih lou tatlekna ah thang a-om; himahleh midiktat in la asa a, akipak hi.
Midiktat in migenthei thu atheihpih a; migilou in huai thei ding in theihsiamna anei kei hi.
Misimmoh hatte'n khopi ahal ua; himahleh mipilte'n thangpaihna aheimang uh.
Mipil in mihai akiselpihleh, aheh hiam anui hiam, khawlna a-om kei ding hi.
Sisan duh a dangtak in amah mihoihkim amudah; huan mitang ahihleh, ahinna azong uhi.
Mihai in ahehna tengteng agen a; himahleh mipil in agenkhe kei a, akhemdai hi.
Vaihawmmi'n zuauthu angaih-khiakleh, asikha tengteng gilou ahi uh.
Migenthei leh nuaisiah hat akituakkhawm ua; TOUPA'N anih tuak uh mitte asukvaksak hi.
Kumpipa ginomtak gentheite ngaihtuah, tangtawn in alaltutphah akip ding hi.
Chiang leh salhna in pilna apia; himahleh naupang ama thuthu a omsak in anu a ding in zumna ahi.
Giloute apun chiang un, tatlekna apung hi; himahleh midiktat in apukna uh a-en ding hi.
Na tapa bawlhoih in, awlna ahon pe ding hi; ahi, na kha a ding in nopna ahon pe ding hi.
Mengmuhna omlouhna ah, mite azautat uh; himahleh kuapeuh dan zui, ama'n nuam asa hi.
Sikha thute a bawlhoih in a-om kei ding; thei mahleh alimsak kei ding.
Athute a kinoh mi na mu hia? Amah sang in mihai a kipan in lametna a-om zaw hi.
Kuapeuh anaupan a kipan a asikha nuamtattak a kem in atawptawp in ama tapa hong hi in anei ding hi.
Miheh in kinakna atokthou a, huan mithangpai in tatlekna ahau hi.
Mihing kisaktheihna in amah alainiam ding; himahleh kuapeuh lungsim kiniamkhiak in pahtawina amu ding.
Kuapeuh guta toh kithuah in amah kha amudah hi; nakpitak a ngetna aza a, huan bangmah agen kei hi.
Mihing kihtakna in thang ahon tawi a; himahleh kuapeuh TOUPA a muanna koih abit ding hi.
Mi tampi'n vaihawmmi deihsakna azong ua; himahleh mihing vaihawmna TOUPA a kipan hong pai ahi.
Midiklou midiktat a ding in kihhuai ahi; huan kuapeuh lampi a tang migilou a ding in kihhuai ahi.
